checkedAlternates.risk: Sodium and calcium are both metals in the same salt-and-minerals area of daily life.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Sodium is in the first column (alkali metals) and calcium is in the second column (alkaline earth metals).

checkedAlternates.risk: Chlorine is a gas at room temperature, like the noble gases.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Chlorine is a reactive halogen, in the group next to the noble gases.

checkedAlternates.risk: Iodine is a solid, unlike chlorine.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Iodine is in the same chemical family as chlorine.
